r.통화: Australian dollar, Tuvaluan dollar · 1 AUD = 891 won
r.경제 체제: Fishing license fees and '.tv' domain income
r.한국이 파는 것: Machinery, computers 46%, Nonwovens, rope 22%, Steel products 10%, Electronics, electrical equipment 7% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system with the British monarch as head of state.

t.why: Rising seas threaten to submerge it. In 2023 it signed a climate migration treaty with Australia.
t.rel: It cooperates with Fiji, Kiribati and other Pacific island states through the Pacific Islands Forum. Under a treaty, Australia helps with its security while Tuvalu needs Australia's consent for security deals with other countries. It continues to recognize Taiwan.
t.know: Leasing its internet domain, '.tv', brings in a large share of government revenue.
t.etext: Tuna fishing rights and fees for its '.tv' internet domain are a large part of revenue. It is extremely vulnerable to rising seas.
